question: GQ-006
subject: closing the launchd survey — two corrections to my own reporting

correction_1_bookkeeping.actual: Zero. Re-enumerating showed all 10 non-78/127 failures already had diagnoses. The "2" was a bookkeeping error in my own table, not a real gap — I subtracted wrong.

correction_2_malformed_plist.claimed: com.siso.hermes.kengine has a malformed plist (invalid XML, ExpatError line 9 col 51).
correction_2_malformed_plist.actual: THE PLIST IS FINE. `plutil -lint` reports OK.
correction_2_malformed_plist.cause: Line 9 is a comment containing `--loop`. A double hyphen inside an XML comment is illegal per spec, so Python's expat rejects it — Apple's parser accepts it. The defect was in MY TOOL, and I reported someone else's working file as broken.
correction_2_malformed_plist.lesson: I used a strict third-party parser on a vendor format and trusted its verdict over the vendor tool. plutil is the authority for plists.

hermes_real_cause.class: MISSING FILE — same defect as the other 29.

consolidation.reading: One deleted virtualenv accounts for four separate job failures. The 30 deleted-path failures are fewer than 30 distinct causes.
